product_metadata.title: Imperial Home 7 Pc Carbon Steel Nonstick Cookware Set, Pots & Pans Set, Cooking Utensils, Cooking Set, Home Essentials, Kitchen Essentials, Frying Pan & Dutch Ovens (Red)
features: VENTED LIDS: Cook quality and delicious tasting food with Imperial Home's cookware sets. Each pot included in this kitchen set includes vented lids to help regulate the cooking temperature and cook time for any dish. The vented glass lids also allows you to see what you're cooking inside allowing for easy, quality cooking.
LONG LASTING: This pots set is made from high grade carbon steel and highly durable, so it’s sure to last in your kitchen for years to come without rusting or tarnishing.

COMFORTABLE HANDLES: This cooking utensils set features stay cool bakelite handles and knobs on each dish allowing you to easily move each cooking pot from a stove top to wherever you need it without burning your hand.

EASY CLEAN UP: Easy to clean up pots and pans for cooking! Each dish in this kitchen set has a thick nonstick interior making cleaning that much easier! Cook any type of food you want in this pot and pan set without having to worry about it getting stuck to the pot and a messy clean up later.
WHAT'S INCLUDED: This kitchen pots and pans set includes a 1.2 qt dutch oven, 1.7 qt dutch oven, 3 qt dutch oven with lids, and a 22 cm frying pan.
description: Imperial Carbon Steel 7 pcs cookware set perfect for everyday cooking. It provides almost all of your table top cooking needs. Tempered glass lids make viewing food easy from start to finish. Set comes in most used sizes; 3qt dutch oven, 1.7qt sauce pan, 1.2qt sauce pan and 9" frying pan.
